in_sanskrit.name: Chenaram
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sky or heaven
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Chenaram एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Originates from the Sanskrit word 'Chena' which means 'sky' or 'heaven'. In Hindu mythology, 'Chena' is also the name of a divine being associated with the sky.

in_tamil.name: செனராம
in_tamil.meaning: சென் (Cen) - great, excellent ராம் (Ram) - God, hero

in_telugu.name: చెనారామ
in_telugu.meaning: చెన్న (Chenna) - great, excellent రామ (Ram) - God, hero

in_marathi.name: Chenaram
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sky or heaven
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chenaram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Originates from the Sanskrit word 'Chena' which means 'sky' or 'heaven'. In Hindu mythology, 'Chena' is also the name of a divine being associated with the sky.

in_bengali.name: Chenaram
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Sky or heaven
in_bengali.long_meaning: Chenaram একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Originates from the Sanskrit word 'Chena' which means 'sky' or 'heaven'. In Hindu mythology, 'Chena' is also the name of a divine being associated with the sky.
